lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gills. A dense cluster of high-intensity spots is located in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots, creating a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low intensity on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent, nearly parallel vertical linear scars are visible crossing the posterior gill slits, characterized by distinct indentations in the epidermal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the ventral-lateral region and pectoral fin by multiple elongated fish silhouettes.
